entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There's been something on[n]my mind for a while now...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's the deal?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Why is the Palace a space[n]station this time?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Why? Well, because...
'Cause "Galaxy Burger."
He sees his company that way.
His heart is a space station.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, yeah. It's gotta be 'cause[n]of Galaxy Burger, right?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But that's only a single[n]product of theirs, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A single hamburger does not[n]birth a whole space station.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, yeah! Cause he sees his[n]company as a space station.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, and so this in turn inspired[n]the "Galaxy Burger"?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But why would his building[n]be a space station...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y-Yeah! Because his heart is[n]a space station!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: His what? I am no stranger to[n]metaphor, but... how is that[n]supposed to make sense?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How the hell should I know?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's true, though. This Palace is[n]kinda weird compared to the[n]ones so far.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Kamoshida's castle... Madarame's[n]museum... Kaneshiro's bank...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right... Futaba's was an exception,[n]but for the others...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Every Palace we've seen has[n]been a materialization of[n]the ruler's desires, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Does Haru's father like space[n]that much?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I don't think so... I've never[n]seen anything like that[n]from him before...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: He sees his employees as robots,[n]which influences their function in[n]his Palace. This much we know.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...But even then, what possible logic[n]could be behind forming his[n]Palace into a space station?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Because space stations are cool as[n]hell? I legitimately do not see the[n]confusion here, Yusuke.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There is intent and meaning in all[n]things' forms. If this form is[n]distorted, there must be a reason.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is it that big a deal?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I mean, even if it is, we'll probably[n]find out at the end of all this.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If that's true, I'd certainly like to[n]know. Let us make haste and[n]clear our path through.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, regardless of the symbolism,[n]we still need to secure a route.
